deployment_mvp2.field_bias_rev3: LIVE 2026-07-19 (main eb557b9, www.autosynth.fun). THE FIELD restored as the single Play steering surface, socket-swapped in for the XY pad (rest of page byte-identical). Steering is the SOFT fiber-choice bias (channel_logbias at ets.writer.tilt.fiber_choice_logits), NOT the region-tilt lane: per-CANDIDATE additive log-weight resolving track_id (roll-up) + unit_id (the ultimate 'channel'), bidirectional amplify/damp [-1,1], single carrier (I-1), byte-identical audio at neutral (is_untilted excludes it -> F/settlement/render unchanged; no root ets/ edit). Drill track->units (role is INTERNAL to training -> a measured fiber no-op / O-block-only, surfaced not built); per-track unit pool (input-level, pre-Gibbs, read-only) so every track drills to its OWN units; participation-ratio noise-floor self-sizing + honest disarm on band-blind/mushy worlds. Preregs (all RATIFIED): channel-bias-squares REV1-soft, REV2-bidirectional, field-bias REV3-unit-grain. ets-auditor PASS across Phase A (mechanism), Phase B (field UI), per-track fix. HONEST WALL kept: track bias is the strong lever (0.20->0.95); single-unit bias is real-but-weak (coverage-contingent). Backup tag: field-bias-rev3-live-2026-07-19. Rollback: pre-uiv6-field-2026-07-17 (pad+XY companion) / pre-sampler-xy-2026-07-19 (pre-bias).
deployment_mvp2.track_role_grid: LIVE 2026-07-20 (www.autosynth.fun). The Play surface as a TRACK x ROLE GRID with row/column/cell bias, each routed to the engine step that WEIGHS its type (the 'seen-through' rule): ROW (track) -> casting/pick (set_channel_bias); CELL (track,role) -> casting/pick (set_track_role_bias); COLUMN (role k) -> SETTLEMENT (payload.region[k] += amp*SAFE_REGION_MAGNITUDE -> set_region). The COLUMN is the honest whole-role handle: a pure-role FIBER push is the measured-inert role wall, so the role amount is steered at SETTLEMENT (region lane) ONLY, never the fiber. All three lanes COEXIST (arrange + cast simultaneously); one region carrier (I-1, the column folds into the same payload.region the KNOBS use); byte-identical when ALL neutral (is_untilted excludes every grain -> F/settlement/render bit-identical); column honestly DISARMS when region sigma=0 (FE dims+tags AND engine layer0 returns lambda=0). REGION_SCALE = ets.panel.envelope.SAFE_REGION_MAGNITUDE (1.0), the engine's own safe cap (same clamp set_region enforces); exposed read-only as /api/world region_cap for FE outbound scaling only. Flag-gated FIELD_GRID_ENABLED (default true; ONE flag back to the drill field, retained dormant+intact). Gate cloud/tools/track_role_grid_verify.py PASS (corpus20 M=5): COLUMN->settlement role-2 0.246->1.000/->0.018 rho=1.000; ROW->pick 0.303->0.984 rho=0.975; CELL->pick 0.083->0.116 rho=0.900; byte-identical-neutral + honest-disarm + coexistence all True; 76 tests green; NO engine edit. Prereg PREREG-track-role-grid.md; ets-auditor PASS (all 8 claims). Rollback: FIELD_GRID_ENABLED=false (drill field) / track-role-drill f3e4a2d / field-bias-rev3 042c274.
deployment_mvp2.track_role_drill: LIVE 2026-07-20 (www.autosynth.fun). Supersedes the track-level-only field: the drill is re-enabled (FIELD_DRILL_ENABLED=true) and re-pointed from units to the EMERGENT (track x role) handle. A track opens into ROLE cells (one per role k it covers, participation-ratio noise-floor gated); each cell damp/amplifies that track's material WITHIN role k via a new THIRD fiber grain (track_role_logbias, keyed (track_id, slot-role k)) on the SAME single TiltTerms.channel_logbias carrier (I-1). This is the first bias steering through a training-EMERGENT structure, and it MEASURABLY DODGES THE ROLE WALL: a pure role addend is a per-choice-set constant (inert, bit-identical), but the track-pinned (T,k) cell varies within the set -> it steers (gate on real M=5 corpus20: cell frac 0.068->0.101 amp / ->0.001 damp, Spearman rho=1.0, byte-identical off, pure-role-inert control confirmed). Magnitude: strong DAMP (surgically remove a track from a role), moderate AMPLIFY (competes with other tracks' role-k material) -- between whole-track (strong) and single-unit (weak). Role cells glow by their OWN (track,role) activity, reconstructed read-only from the committed O (mass-conserving -> byte-identical audio). Units retained DORMANT behind the flag; ONE-FLAG SHELVE-ABLE (FIELD_DRILL_ENABLED=false restores track-level-only). Prereg PROMOTED+RATIFIED (PREREG-track-role-bias.md); ets-auditor PASS on mechanism (6f00fff) + FE drill (d860937). No root ets/ edit; fiber-measure only.
